title: Phase 2 stop condition validation
description: Final validation that all Phase 2 stop conditions from docs/ARCHITECTURE.md are met: (1) Dependency cycles are detected and rejected by the validation tool, (2) A child task cannot start execution if its parent epic is blocked, (3) An epic cannot complete if any of its children are incomplete, (4) The picker never selects a task whose dependencies are not satisfied, (5) The project dashboard output includes the dependency chain for each item. Run all tests, verify tool outputs, and confirm each condition with evidence.
stop_condition: All 5 Phase 2 stop conditions evaluate to true. Phase 2 is declared complete.
